title: MS PROBE

lines.text: — last · avg · max ms · tap ▶ to open —

description: MS PROBE — the hierarchical millisecond profiler. Every probed code path reports wall-clock ms into a dot-path tree (physics.grav, physics.spring, render.trails…), collapsible by prefix. This is the deciding witness for all optimization votes: the grav/spring/coll/cache split on the POCO is the standing gate before further optimization. Gates key on these dot-labels. If a number here didn't move, the optimization didn't happen.
